basis: The chart shows the 2005 endpoint at 23.9°C and the 2014 endpoint at 10.1°C, giving a full-period change of 10.1 - 23.9 = -13.8°C. This is a large, sustained downward shift over the review period. No threshold is printed, but the magnitude and consistent trend support treating it as a substantial change rather than ordinary variation.
option_label: Route the 2005 to 2014 summer temperature change to substantial-change follow-up
